description: Use this tool when the user wants to connect an account on a selected social network. It starts OAuth authorization and returns an auth_link that the user must open and approve. It requires network_id and network_type_id obtained from networks.list. network_type_id 0 means profile, 1 means page, and 2 means group. The connection is not complete until the user finishes authorization. Pinterest also requires an active custom app assigned to the API service.

language.description: Optional language for the authorization flow, for example en or de.

network_id.description: Social media network ID returned by the networks.list tool.

name: connections.add

auth_link.description: Authorization URL that must be opened to connect the account.

expired_in.description: Number of seconds until the authorization session expires.

session_token.description: Session token for the authorization process.

title: Connect a social media account
